name: block-compare-table
use: What changes for the reader: rows side by side, life without the product on the left and with it on the right, all visible at once.
avoid: One case told at length; numbers that prove a claim (take block-metrics).
props: { kind: 'block-compare-table'; title: string; head: [string, string]; rows: [string, string][] }

cases.title: What changes for a shop that takes card payments
cases.why: Each row names a pain and its answer side by side.

props.title: What changes for you
head: Without it
With the Stripe element
rows: Each site needs its own Stripe integration
Each element makes one call and gets a payment link
Your Stripe keys are copied into every project
The keys live in this element and are checked with Stripe before they are saved
Every app writes and protects its own webhook
One webhook checks the signature of Stripe and records each event once
